build.buildCommand: pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile && pnpm --filter @travelpoint/geo build && pnpm --filter @travelpoint/types build && pnpm --filter @travelpoint/utils build && pnpm --filter @travelpoint/validation build && pnpm --filter @travelpoint/api db:generate && pnpm --filter @travelpoint/api build

deploy.startCommand: cd apps/api && npx prisma migrate deploy && node dist/server.js
